purpose: Phase 1 independent Canvas 2D water-light direction, motion, strength and exit review
authority: Candidate implementation baseline; frozen SWOS timing and WATER_REGION_REAL_CATCH_V1 geometry are reused unchanged. V5 shape and optical values remain provisional and require product owner visual review.

asset.exif_orientation: No EXIF orientation tag detected; decoded dimensions match stored pixel orientation.

display.canvas_overlay: same stage; one shared contain content rectangle and source-native water_region transform

asset.note: Execution-time SHA-256 and decoded dimensions must match before the region renderer is enabled.

water_region.annotation_method: Manual polygon annotation by full-resolution visual inspection of the fixed original photo. Polygon edges were placed conservatively inside visibly open water and away from the fish, person, shoreline, rocks and sky.
water_region.safety_margin: Conservative inset of approximately 20–40 source pixels beside the person and fish where the visible boundary permits; shoreline inset at least 16 source pixels. The geometry and browser overlay remain subject to review.

polygons.description: Open water along the left photo edge beside the fish; the polygon follows a conservative gap around the fish and widens below its tail while remaining left of the person.
Open lake surface to the right of the person, with an inset below the rocky far bank, around the extended forearm and hand, and above the foreground rocks.

validation.source_visual_review: Original 1152×1536 JPEG inspected with source-pixel grid; water polygons deliberately avoid fish, person, visible far shoreline and foreground bank.

browser_review.result: Both polygons remain inside visibly open water; the fish, person, shoreline, foreground bank, sky and land are excluded in the browser-rendered overlay. Automated composite leak count is zero.

rendering.water_region_clip: source-native polygon path plus precomputed blurred-inward alpha mask; clip is rebuilt from the shared object-fit:contain content rectangle on resize
rendering.texture_generation: A seeded, spatially distributed set of short anisotropic organic surface patches is precomputed inside each source-native water polygon. Patch centerlines, asymmetric widths, necks and edge variation are deterministic; one smooth expansion field grows them from P1 through P3, then staggered per-patch contraction and peripheral retreat disperse the field through P5-P7. No frame-local random geometry, full-width ribbons, circles or regular mesh.

diagnostics.previous_v1_root_cause: Irregular soft patches were distributed across the full photo coordinate rectangle; no water-region polygon restricted the overlay.
diagnostics.v2_change: Replace full-photo blobs with a water-region-clipped ambient field, shared-edge organic caustic mesh and sparse refraction curves. Keep the frozen timeline unchanged.

parameter_change_log.before: 0.08–0.92 of full image width and height; all 30 textured patches could cover non-water content
parameter_change_log.after: Two source-native hand-marked water polygons; every layer is clipped to the water region
parameter_change_log.reason: The first proven failure was full-frame light spill onto sky, fish, person and bank.

parameter_change_log.before: 5 broad + 17 caustic + 8 refracted soft irregular textures; layer alpha 0.19 / 0.28 / 0.18
parameter_change_log.after: Water-only ambient field alpha 0.16 + bloom 0.08; shared-edge caustic cell alpha 0.15; sparse refraction curve alpha 0.19
parameter_change_log.reason: Replace detached blurred blobs with a connected, smoothly deforming water-surface field; these coefficients belong to the new composition model and are candidate values, not a one-to-one brightness mapping.

parameter_change_log.before: expansion 0.24; upward movement 0.085 of full photo height; recollection scale reduction 0.13
parameter_change_log.after: mesh expansion 0.055 and upward movement 0.055 of each water polygon height; recollection scale reduction 0.045
parameter_change_log.reason: Drive movement inside the annotated water shape and reduce whole-patch displacement that made the old fields float over the photograph.
Preserve frozen SWOS timings and business decisions; calibrate only candidate rendering structure and layer parameters.

parameter_change_log.before: Jittered mesh cells with visible shared polygon seams and connected grid-edge highlights.
parameter_change_log.after: 8–22 source-native smooth, elongated ribbons per water polygon, 18–46 source-pixel width, slowly deforming from precomputed deterministic control samples; sparse ribbon-aligned refraction glints.
parameter_change_log.reason: Browser composite screenshots showed the mesh read as a geometric polygon grid and was too subtle as natural caustics. Curved bands retain deterministic continuity while removing cell seams.

parameter_change_log.before: Per-ribbon blur filtering on 28–31 broad bands, with 10-segment curves.
parameter_change_log.after: 20–21 source-native ribbons for the fixed polygons, eight curve segments, gradient-softened edges without per-ribbon blur filters.
parameter_change_log.reason: Chromium playback profiling showed the initial ribbon composite missed the minimum sample rate; remove repeated filter passes and reduce path work while retaining enough spatial coverage for the measured visibility gates.

parameter_change_log.before: ambient_alpha 0.18; ambient_bloom_alpha 0.09; refraction_alpha 0.13; max_layer_alpha 0.24; caustic_ribbon_alpha 0.74; ribbon edge/core alpha 0.25/0.62; refraction width 1.45 source px
parameter_change_log.after: ambient_alpha 0.22; ambient_bloom_alpha 0.11; refraction_alpha 0.17; max_layer_alpha 0.34; caustic_ribbon_alpha 0.90; ribbon edge/core alpha 0.32/0.80; refraction width 1.7 source px
parameter_change_log.reason: Live exact-SHA P0/P3 browser screenshots showed that pixel metrics and the difference map passed while the caustic peak remained too subdued at normal display size. Increase the water-only ribbon contrast and restrained refraction highlights; keep color family, geometry, motion, polygon clipping and frozen P0-P7 timings unchanged. Recheck the composited screenshot for naturalness and overexposure.

parameter_change_log.before: V4 deterministic, near-full-width curved ribbons with longitudinal lanes, which still read as parallel horizontal water bands in the composited browser screenshot.
parameter_change_log.after: Source-native short organic face patches with anisotropic dimensions, varied orientations, asymmetric edge profiles, gentle necks and deterministic centerline deformation; two existing water polygons remain the sole clip.
parameter_change_log.reason: Remove the ribbon basis that produced periodic horizontal bands while keeping the fixed asset, masks, Canvas 2D and water-only leak boundary unchanged.

parameter_change_log.before: Each full-width ribbon oscillated and translated independently; reveal and exit mostly changed global ribbon opacity.
parameter_change_log.after: A shared growth field expands each fixed patch from P1 into P2-P3, a deterministic radial advection changes location, and per-patch size contraction plus staggered peripheral weighting retract the field through P5-P7.
parameter_change_log.reason: Create observable spatial expansion and area retreat rather than relying on additional random patches or a single global alpha curve.

parameter_change_log.before: V4 1440x1000 WebM captured the Canvas workbench with the photo's upper portion clipped by nested page scrolling.
parameter_change_log.after: Before playback, scroll the fixed photo into the capture viewport, click Play without locator-driven auto-scroll, assert the photo content rectangle is stable at playback start and end, then extract P0–P7 from the actual WebM and compare each recorded crop with an unlit source reference (full-photo comparison for P0/P7, non-water comparison for every frame).
parameter_change_log.reason: V4 clipped the upper photo area; V5's initial preflight-only check missed a scroll caused by the Playwright locator click. Post-start geometry and extracted-frame pixel comparisons now verify that the full photo remains visible during the actual recording.

diagnostics.v3_change: Replace the visible polygon-cell mosaic and grid-aligned edge highlights with a deterministic curved ribbon field: soft cross-ribbon alpha gradients create face-like caustics without per-ribbon blur filters; a few aligned low-alpha centerline glints form layer C. The water-only mask and P0–P7 timeline are unchanged.
diagnostics.v4_change: Calibrate water-only mid-stage composite visibility after reviewing paired live P0/P3 screenshots at the normal 1440x1000 browser viewport. Only rendering-layer alpha and refraction width changed; topology, water geometry, elapsed-time motion, original image and frozen timeline remain unchanged.
diagnostics.v5_change: Replace the V4 ribbon-based caustic topology and movement with deterministic organic anisotropic face patches; keep the original photo, manual water polygons, Canvas 2D mask, controls, 2800ms duration, P0-P7 timings/intensities, and reduced-motion boundary. The actual WebM is checked by extracting all eight frames and comparing their photo crops to the unlit source.

visual_acceptance.candidate_parameter_changes: CANDIDATE_V5 replaces full-width horizontal ribbon geometry with deterministic irregular local face patches and staged patch growth, outward spread, staggered contraction and peripheral retreat. The original P0-P7 frame times, intensity baselines, fixed photo and two manually marked water polygons are unchanged. V5 has not received product owner visual sign-off.
